name: Pancreas-diabetes-1.1
description: A binary histology image classification dataset consisting of 90  RGB microscopy images of pancreatic tissue acquired at 100x magnification  with a resolution of 1280x960 pixels. The dataset includes 58 images of  normal pancreatic tissue and 32 images of glucose-intolerant tissue.  Intended for research in medical image analysis, supervised learning,  low-data classification, and explainable AI.
creator: L. Rato, F.C. Silva, A.R. Costa, C. Antunes
citation: Rato L., Silva F.C., Costa A.R., Antunes C. (2025). Pancreas-diabetes: Histology Image Dataset for Binary Classification. In preparation.
